next.appdoc.needsAppText: The document stays where it is. Install the app and it can be edited again.
next.appdoc.readOnly: The document is open for reading only
next.appdoc.code.newer: It was made by a newer version of the app than the one installed here. Update the app.
next.appdoc.code.failed: The app could not bring it up to its own version. The document is untouched.
next.appdoc.code.no-room: There was no room to keep the old copy next to the new one. The document is untouched.
next.appdoc.code.unreadable: The version or the content of the document could not be read. It is untouched.
next.appdoc.code.no-package: The app's package cannot be read, so the document cannot be brought up to date. It is untouched.
next.appdoc.code.view-only: You can view this document but not change it.

next.appdoc.noView: The app has no view that edits this document
